resources.string: Programmatically wait for a second tap in Doze/AOD mode. Use if the hardware double tap doesn\'t work.
Standard battery thermal limits. Ensures maximum safety and longevity.
Slight increase in battery temperature limits (threshold raised by 5°C). Slightly improves performance in warm conditions while maintaining safety.
Balanced increase in battery temperature limits (threshold raised by 9°C).
WARNING: Significant increase in battery temperature limits (threshold raised by 15°C). \nMay lead to severe heating, reduced lifespan, and potential battery damage.
EXTREME DANGER: Complete disablement of battery thermal management (threshold raised by 90°C). \nUse strictly at your own risk. May cause overheating, irreversible damage, and void the warranty.
Standard SoC thermal control. Strong throttling when heating up to maintain optimal temperature.
Slight reduction in SoC throttling (threshold raised by 5°C). Boosts performance at the cost of a minor increase in heat.
Balanced reduction in SoC throttling (threshold raised by 9°C). A good compromise between performance and heat.
WARNING: Aggressive reduction in SoC throttling (threshold raised by 15°C). \nProvides maximum performance but may cause very severe case heating and system instability.

EXTREME DANGER: Complete disablement of SoC thermal management (threshold raised by 90°C). \nLeads to maximum throttling, instability, potential component damage, and voids the warranty. Use for testing only.
Reboot is not required. Based on tests, the configuration is applied immediately, but it is better to restart the device to guarantee stability.
Based on my tests, restarting the device is required for the correct application of this config. \n\nWithout a reboot, unstable CPU frequencies or incorrect charging behavior may occur.
